chapter: Learning, lawn parties and band rivalries
title: Uniformed dance bands and Hippolyte Charles's saxophone orchestra
summary: Dawson describes the Olympia and Eureka dance bands in uniform, Hippolyte Charles's reading band with two saxes and a conservatory-trained leader, and the Blaze Away and Golden Rule bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
